name: Vavuniya Tank Falls
description: Vavuniya Tank Falls, a stunning cascade located in the Northern Province, showcases the intricate engineering and natural beauty of ancient tank systems. This picturesque site is a testament to the ingenuity of early Sri Lankan farmers who created these water storage reservoirs to sustain their communities.
monsoon_note: Access road floods during monsoon. Check local conditions.

name: Omanthai Falls
description: Omanthai Falls, a breathtaking plunge into nature’s splendor, stands as a testament to Vavuniya’s untouched beauty. Surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant wildlife, this picturesque site offers a refreshing experience for hikers and nature lovers alike.
monsoon_note: Dry season (Feb-May) best for hiking. Paths muddy in monsoon.

name: Cheddikulam Falls
description: Cheddikulam Falls, a stunning tiered cascade nestled in the Northern Province, offers visitors a breathtaking sight of nature’s splendor. Surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant wildlife, this picturesque location is perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape from the hustle of daily life.

name: Nedunkerni Falls
description: Nedunkerni Falls, a stunning natural wonder in Vavuniya, Northern Province, offers breathtaking views and refreshing waterfalls that cascade into crystal-clear pools. Witness the power of nature at its finest, perfect for both relaxation and adventure.
monsoon_note: Best visited Jan-Apr. Paths may flood during monsoon.

name: Vavuniya Town Falls
description: Vavuniya Town Falls, a breathtaking cascade located in the heart of Vavuniya district, showcases the raw power of nature with its cascading waters that form a picturesque pool below. This natural wonder is a testament to the region's rich biodiversity and historical significance, offering visitors a serene escape from the hustle of daily life.

name: Parayanalankulam Falls
description: Parayanalankulam Falls, a majestic plunge into nature’s splendor, stands as a testament to Vavuniya’s untouched beauty. Surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant wildlife, these falls offer a refreshing escape from the hustle of daily life, perfect for those seeking tranquility and adventure.

name: Thandikulam Falls
description: Thandikulam Falls, a stunning horsetail waterfall in Vavuniya, Northern Province, offers visitors a breathtaking sight where the river narrows dramatically, creating a picturesque cascade that is a testament to nature's raw power and beauty.

name: Veppankulam Falls
description: Veppankulam Falls, a stunning cascade nestled in the Northern Province, offers visitors a breathtaking sight where water plunges dramatically into a serene pool below. This natural wonder is a testament to Sri Lanka’s rich biodiversity and geological diversity.
monsoon_note: Flash floods possible Jun-Sep. Stay on marked trails.

name: Puliyankulam Falls
description: Puliyankulam Falls, a breathtaking natural wonder in Vavuniya, Northern Province, offers visitors a unique spectacle of water cascading over rocks. This serene spot is perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape amidst nature’s splendor.
monsoon_note: Peak flow Nov-Jan due to NE monsoon. Spectacular but risky.

name: Vavuniya North Falls
description: Vavuniya North Falls, a stunning horsetail waterfall located in the heart of Vavuniya district, Northern Province, offers visitors a breathtaking sight with its cascading waters and lush greenery. This natural wonder is a testament to nature’s power and beauty, perfect for those seeking a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life.

name: Kovilkulam Falls
description: Kovilkulam Falls, a stunning cascade located in the Northern Province, Vavuniya district, is a breathtaking natural wonder. Surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant wildlife, this picturesque spot offers a refreshing experience for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.
monsoon_note: Roads may be impassable during heavy rain. 4WD recommended.
